root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: at least two bytes remain in the nested child slice before the uint16 length header is read
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Inside the `da_is_length_field(parent)` branch of the nested `fr_struct_from_network()` call, the decoder must enforce `end - p >= 2` before `struct_len = (p[0] << 8) | p[1]` executes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable nested `STRUCT a` decoder reads a 16-bit length header from the remaining child slice without first checking that the slice still contains both header bytes.

nodes.state: Immediately before the nested length read, `p + 1 == end`, so the second byte consumed by `p[1]` is exactly one past the remaining child slice.

edges.relation: The nested cursor `p` checked for the missing two-byte obligation is reused unchanged by the subsequent `struct_len = (p[0] << 8) | p[1]` read.
The trailing RR payload pointer selected for recursive substruct decoding is passed unchanged as the nested call's length-header cursor `p`.
